newsitem.title: USA: Precision Optic development to hurt results.
newsitem.headline: Precision Optic development to hurt results.

text.p: Precision Optic Corp Inc said on Friday costs associated with its development of wavelength division multiplexer optical filters could hurt results in the next several quarters.
The company said it had a promising start last quarter developing prototypes of these filters.
It also said it reduced its total workforce by six people, or about 10 percent, due to continued uncertainty in the night vision market.

"As a result of recent fluctuations in assembly and testing activities and with continued uncertainty in the night vision market throughout the coming year, the company has reduced its production workforce by six people," it said.

Precision Optic said the filters should be produced by the end of this calendar year and that wavelength division multiplexer optical filters represented an emerging billiion dollar market by the year 2000.
For the second quarter ended December 31, the company reported earnings of $0.01 per share compared to nil earnings in the year-ago quarter.
